scope: Waterfront concept V4.2.1: 11 chapters, 13 programme elements, eight family-house concept views, responsive WebP and capability-selected AV1 films with H.264 fallback
notes: Official website provenance does not make promotional images documentary photographs.
Masterplan13 is a user-selected concept; no as-built claim.
Fonts self-hosted; original OFL licenses preserved.
SVG copied byte-for-byte; no scripts or external image references detected.
NASA imagery is historical composited data; cinematic globe lighting and cloud motion are not live observations.
Generated v2 architectural images illustrate a proposed atmosphere and do not document existing construction.
Rendered wheel includes 129 source-extracted static parts, an authored rotor and clean presentation cabins; not a complete or engineering-certified as-built model.
Attraction geometry and source maps remain private. Episode03 uses offline EEVEE-rendered geometry with a generated camera-matched coastal background; no attraction mesh is served.
The episode03 assembly is illustrative, not a construction method; the proposed setting is not an as-built photograph.
WOFF2 fonts preserve complete glyphs and shaping; original source fonts and OFL licenses retained.
No new paid subscription required; public Instagram and YouTube footage informed visual research and is not republished.

Episode04 is a rendered engineering-paper and architectural-model sequence from the canonical thirteen-element programme, followed by a deliberate dissolve to art-directed day and night concepts. It is not a construction method, surveyed site or pixel-registered morph.
New human-scale waterfront and cafe views are source-guided design interpretations. The design-table print is a generated study of the canonical concept panorama.

Chapter02 uses real Sentinel-2 observation from2026-09-26 with Copernicus DEM. The3Dperspective is an interpreted terrain view, not surveyed buildings. Attribution is provided in data/geography-v4/credits.html. OSM is an error fallback only.

Chapter05 and new beach/hospitality/festival/final images are AI-assisted concept visualizations. They are not native Blender renders, documentary photography, verified architectural plans or pixel-registered model output. Working supplied models remain preserved and private.

Four hospitality clusters of6–8lodges are a proposed programme (24–32lodges); the artwork depicts6percluster. Eastward expansion and dedicated beach amenities require site, land-rights and coastal studies. No guaranteed tourism, jobs, returns or off-grid operation is asserted.
The exact official Oman flag is sourced from the Foreign Ministry. Leadership and Vision2040 facts cite official sources; alignment is not endorsement.
Final expanded panorama has a bounded5second settling motion; no new AIvideo or live attraction models are served.
Historic V2/V3 assets retained in this manifest are not all used by the current 11 chapters. V4.2 responsive artwork and AV1 films are under media/v42/.

Public sharing previews and icons use the supplied logo palette. Social aerial is a proposed development concept, not a completed resort. Metadata is indexable; actual search indexing and messenger cache refresh are separate external outcomes.

V4.1 adds smaller same-timeline H.264 delivery variants. Playback begins with a short buffered runway; slow loading permits one downshift before a finished still. The original high-quality source films remain preserved. No raw attraction models are public.

V4.2 family-house views were generated with built-in ImageGen for the project brief: three exterior and five interior concept perspectives. They suggest a single-storey two-bedroom, two-bathroom home with a private garden and pool; they are not photographs of an existing house, measured plans or a coordinated engineering model.

V4.2 responsive WebP variants are encoded from 18 preserved original PNG compositions, not from the older lossy WebP files. Their largest dimensions do not exceed the originals. Tiny previews are loading states rather than finished-quality display assets.

V4.2 AV1 WebM films are encoded from preserved native 1080p PNG sources and accepted timing. Wheel remains 13 seconds; masterplan remains 10 seconds. Existing H.264 variants remain available at matching resolutions for compatibility. Source PNG sequences and DCC files are not distributed.

Responsive selection and capability checks improve delivery choices; file size and local decode checks do not guarantee public throughput. Higher-detail 1080p AV1 files are larger than the prior default 720p H.264 files, while smaller 720p/540p choices and finished stills remain available.
